reason_for_v2: V1 showed that an absolute allocated/live threshold of 4 is miscalibrated because fresh rebuilt managers themselves can have ratios above 4. V2 freezes relative-to-last-fresh triggers before new outcomes and uses new sizes/seeds.

holdout.game: generated monotone simple game from subset-minimal random supports; new streams not used in V1

strategies.periodic_32: rebuild every 32 effective boundary changes since last rebuild
strategies.relative_1_5: after an initialization fresh baseline at the first effective update, rebuild when current allocated/live ratio >= 1.5 times the ratio immediately after the previous fresh rebuild
strategies.hybrid_relative2_or_64: rebuild when relative multiplier reaches 2.0 or 64 effective updates since the previous rebuild

baseline_semantics: For relative strategies the first effective boundary state is freshly rebuilt once as initialization, its allocated/live ratio is the baseline, and later rebuilds replace that baseline with the new fresh ratio. Initialization is reported separately and not counted as a trigger rebuild.
correctness_oracle: At every effective update independently fresh-rebuild current reduced boundary and require exact full rank-vector equality for every strategy; oracle time excluded from strategy runtime.

memory_proxy: maximum ratio relative to last-fresh baseline
cost_accounting.reporting: Keep runtime and memory separate; report cell-wise and aggregate comparisons to periodic_32 and always_incremental.

predeclared_tests: Compare relative_1_5 and relative_2_0 trigger counts; a useful relative trigger should fire materially less than V1 absolute ratio_4 while lowering stale-state proxies versus always_incremental.
Compare relative_2_0 to periodic_32; report cell count of runtime and memory wins, without after-outcome scalarization.
Compare hybrid_relative2_or_64 to relative_2_0 to detect whether a periodic backstop catches long low-ratio drift.
No conclusion extends beyond these monotone-game streams or establishes asymptotic behavior.
scope: Twelve new small monotone-game streams. Relative trigger multipliers are exploratory but frozen before V2 outcomes.
